hook: Your photo of Lake Natron can show blood-red water.
title: Tanzania's lake with blood-red water
description:
Lake Natron in northern Tanzania can look blood red. The water is very salty and alkaline, and dead birds and animals can get coated in crusty mineral deposits. Flamingos still nest there. Part of the series 'Places That Shouldn't Exist'.

#Shorts #LakeNatron #Geography
